description: Gate an agent's actions and leave a signed receipt for each one: a published rules document decides, anything that commits is held for a person's approval, and every decision is recorded in a chain somebody else can verify without trusting the agent or the machine it runs on.

interface.shortDescription: A signed receipt for every action
interface.longDescription: Gate an agent's actions and leave a signed receipt for each one: a published rules document decides, anything that commits is held for a person's approval, and every decision is recorded in a chain somebody else can verify without trusting the agent or the machine it runs on. The receipt carries no code and no parameters — only what was observed, what was decided, under which document, and who approved it. Verification needs three files and no access to the agent.
